articles.title: Language barriers increasing risk of drug mishaps in Australia
articles.summary: Experts say more needs to be done to improve communication about medications with culturally and linguistically diverse populations.

articles.title: Winnipeg man who once fled Somalia as refugee sentenced to 4 years for human smuggling
articles.summary: A man who once fled to Winnipeg as a Somalian refugee will spend the next 500 days behind bars after admitting to making money smuggling immigrants across the Canada-U.S. border.

articles.title: Prince Harry and Meghan will move back to the United Kingdom, source says
articles.summary: Prince Harry and his family will leave the sunny shores of southern California and return to the United Kingdom, a source familiar with the couple’s plans said.
